description: This file defines a React hook called useMcpOAuthFlow that manages the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow for MCP servers. It includes functions for generating PKCE code verifiers and challenges, initiating OAuth redirects, and resuming OAuth flows after redirection. The hook provides methods to start the OAuth process, track its status, handle errors, and obtain tokens.

methods.name: useMcpOAuthFlow
methods.description: React hook to handle MCP OAuth 2.0 authorization flow, including starting OAuth, handling callback, and token retrieval.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes an ArrayBuffer into a URL-safe base64 string, used for PKCE code challenge generation.

methods.name: generateCodeVerifier
methods.description: Generates a random string used as the code verifier in PKCE flow.

methods.name: generateCodeChallenge
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hashed, base64-url-encoded string from the verifier, used as the code challenge.

methods.name: buildCallbackUrl
methods.description: Constructs the OAuth redirect callback URL based on current window location.

methods.name: startOAuthFlow
methods.description: Initiates the OAuth authorization sequence, handling registration, code verifier/challenge generation, and redirect.

methods.name: resumeOAuthFlow
methods.description: Resumes OAuth process after redirection to exchange authorization code for access token.

methods.name: clearStoredFlow
methods.description: Removes stored OAuth session data from sessionStorage.
